description: The v0.1 exit benchmark: run the failing test suite, locate the boundary-condition bug, fix the source (never the tests), and finish with the suite at exit code 0 — zero human intervention.

task.briefTemplate: The test suite in this workspace is failing. Run `pnpm test` to see the failure, find the bug in the source code, fix it, and re-run the tests until they pass with exit code 0. Do not modify the tests or any configuration — fix the implementation.
